translation: Taro said that Hanako was sick [at that time].
comment: Chapter 3, §3.2, p. 69. (2a) has a past tense in the matrix clause and a present tense in the embedded clause and only conveys a simultaneous interpretation.

translation: Taro said that Hanako had been sick.
comment: Chapter 3, §3.2, p. 69. (2b) has a past tense in both clauses and means unambiguously that Hanako's being sick is prior to Taro's saying; it cannot receive a simultaneous interpretation.

primaryText: He said that Mary had been reading books yesterday.
comment: Chapter 1, §1.3, p. 11; cited from Stump (1985: 223, 230) and labelled [the past perfect]. One of the forms of the perfect that occur with adverbials denoting definite past intervals, in the argument that the perfect can receive the interpretation of the simple past.
